$comment: IC workspace (dogfood): block cross-repo edits/commits to the toolkit PRIMARY checkout. This workspace stays writable on master; only the linked toolkit checkout is guarded. Commands are wrapped so a MULTI-ROOT Cursor session cannot deadlock: ${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR} resolves to ONE root, which may be a repo with no AIOS guard — unwrapped, /bin/sh exits 127 (script not found) and failClosed turns that into a policy DENY across the whole session. The wrapper decides on the MARKER FILE .aios-toolkit-version, which exists only in a scaffolded AIOS workspace. Marker ABSENT means this root is not an AIOS workspace and the hook does not apply (exit 0); marker PRESENT but the script missing means a real workspace whose guard was deleted, which is exit 3 (could-not-evaluate, mapped to a block) so the guard cannot be bypassed by removing a file. The marker is deliberately NOT .cursor/hooks: that directory is a generic Cursor convention an unrelated root may have for its own hooks, and treating it as 'AIOS guard installed' would block that root entirely. The check is inline because a helper script would sit at the same unresolvable path.

beforeShellExecution.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -f "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard is installed here but $p is missing" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.aios-toolkit-version" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/guard-toolkit-primary.sh" pre_command

preToolUse.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -f "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard is installed here but $p is missing" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.aios-toolkit-version" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/guard-toolkit-primary.sh" pre_edit

stop.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -f "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard is installed here but $p is missing" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.aios-toolkit-version" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/toolkit-primary-tripwire.sh"
